before:
review = load("root-full-review.json")
assert review["status"] == "ROOT_ACCEPTED_FOR_OFFICIAL_INSTALL_AND_AUDIT" and review["source_sha256"] == selected_sha and review["source_lines"] == source_lines
assert review["public_heads"] == [namespace + short for short in short_names]
assert review["complete_public_type_root_review"] == review["independent_complete_public_type_review"] == "CLEAR"
assert review["root_read_complete_public_types"] and review["root_printed_type_lexical_identity_verified"] and review["four_private_markers_and_all_helpers_absent_from_type"]
assert review["raw_type_byte_identity_by_head"] == {short: head_metrics[short]["raw_type_byte_identity"] for short in short_names}
assert all(review.get(key, all(head_metrics[short]["raw_type_byte_identity"] for short in short_names)) == all(head_metrics[short]["raw_type_byte_identity"] for short in short_names) for key in ["root_printed_type_byte_identity_verified", "check_print_type_byte_identity"])
assert review["types_sha256"] == {short: head_metrics[short]["type_sha256"] for short in short_names}
assert review["full_raw_sha256"] == digest(raw) and review["actual_axioms_by_head"] == actual_by_head
assert review["body_retained_and_programmatically_checked"] and review["whole_body_manual_read_claimed"] is False
after:
review_raw = (evidence / "root-full-review.json").read_bytes()
assert digest(review_raw) == "9e392ab14499c472385d1451c3553c8d4ea58083b2a2b6841dbeeeb5b9911116"
review = json.loads(review_raw)
assert review["status"] == "ROOT_ACCEPTED" and review["source_sha256"] == selected_sha
assert review["complete_public_type_root_review"] == review["independent_complete_public_type_review"] == "CLEAR"
assert review["source_complete_root_and_independent_reviews"] is True and review["whole_goal_complete"] is False
assert review["root_printed_type_lexical_identity_verified"] is True
assert review["raw_type_byte_identity_by_head"] == {short: head_metrics[short]["raw_type_byte_identity"] for short in short_names}
public_review_raw = (evidence / "public-audit/review.json").read_bytes()
assert digest(public_review_raw) == review["independent_review_sha256"] == "ddf13e9c4202083729251192735e99b414197aaf5f49cbb4595b8515ee3da548"
public_review = json.loads(public_review_raw)
assert public_review["status"] == "CLEAR" and public_review["scope"] == "INDEPENDENT_COMPLETE_ACTUAL_PUBLIC_TYPE_AND_READBACK_REVIEW"
assert (public_review["source_sha256"], public_review["source_lines"], public_review["public_head"]) == (selected_sha, source_lines, namespace + short_names[0])
metric = head_metrics[short_names[0]]
assert public_review["TYPE"] == dict(logical_lines=metric["type_logical_lines"], LF=metric["type_line_feeds"], final_LF=metric["type_final_newline"], bytes=metric["type_bytes"], characters=metric["type_characters"], sha256=metric["type_sha256"])
assert public_review["manual_read"]["checked_TYPE_all_logical_lines"] == metric["type_logical_lines"]
assert public_review["manual_read"]["printed_TYPE_byte_identity_programmatically_checked"] is public_review["check_print_type_byte_identity"] is metric["raw_type_byte_identity"]
assert public_review["manual_read"]["printed_TYPE_manually_read"] is public_review["manual_read"]["whole_BODY_manual_read"] is False
assert all(public_review[key] is True for key in ["check_print_type_lexical_identity", "actual_axioms_within_standard_allowed", "private_or_dagger_TYPE_spellings_absent", "BODY_retention_programmatic_only"])
assert public_review["private_helper_names"] == helpers and review["actual_axioms"] == public_review["actual_axioms"] == actual_by_head[short_names[0]]
assert public_review["whole_goal_complete"] is False and public_review["hidden_success_or_final_certificate_premise"] is False
